_note: Offline catalogue for refcheck_smoke.jsonl. Hand-written from well-known bibliographic facts (title, authors, year, DOI/arXiv id) because this project does not fetch live data in tests; it is NOT a recording of a live API response. refcheck_bench.fixture_lookup serves these records through the real arxiv_lookup and crossref_lookup: an arXiv id resolves to its record, and any title query returns the five best word-overlap candidates, related or not, as a catalogue search does.
